name: Vitreous-Erg
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs dust seas stretching to horizon, stark under a black sky.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
For traders, silicon, titanium and platinum alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
